title: Kamishiro Rui — Admiring My Treasures〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
—Now, let's move on to the magic scene.
Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping us out today.
We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's our pleasure. We owe you all a great deal, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Besides, this is valuable practice for us too, while we wait for the next training period with the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By the way, do we have the bags of beads for the magic effect?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah! I left them in the wings. I'll go get them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That magic effect is so fun!
All the pretty beads just pouring out of the box!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just a hopper hidden by the tablecloth, though. You can even hear it running if you listen closely.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. In the story, the protagonist knows he could get found out at any moment, but he's working to make his highly skilled friend's magic look good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And... Hup☆
I brought the beads♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you brought the backups too? Thank you. Weren't they heavy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
Not at all! I just lift them like this, and it's totally fine♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah! If you swing them around like that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, no! The beads are going everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear. They've even started rolling backstage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's not just stand and watch it happen!
Come on, start picking up beads!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ah, Rui, there are some by your left foot there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's okay, Miku! With all of us working together, we'll have them all picked up in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. Besides, it may be my fault to begin with. I may have overfilled the sacks with regard to their tensile strength.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
When you have friends, you have the whole world!
I swear I'll make this up to you someday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A line from Miku's character, the protagonist's friend, who ends the show having taken a big step closer to his goal thanks to the protagonist's help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When you have friends, you have the whole world...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, we're almost done here. Let's make one last push—
“Huh... I don't really get it, but that's cool, I guess.”
“Aw, man. Why's Teach only ever say nice things to Rui?”
“That's just how it is. It's 'cuz he's a genius. That's what my mom says.”
“I wish I was as smart as you, Rui.”
“I'm not doing this just because you think it's fun!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The voices are coming from... There.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? This is some kind of...fragment?
It's glowing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We did find those round “fragments of feelings” before. I wonder if this is related...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rui! What are you doing over here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you hear those weird voices earlier?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perfect timing, you two. Could you have a look at this for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I found this fragment over here.
Could it possibly be—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps we've wandered into another fragment SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, it does seem kind of similar...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm a little scared too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(The air feels stagnant here...
No, not just stagnant. The very atmosphere is heavy and oppressive.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And there's a sharp edge to it...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It feels like there's someone here stewing in rage.

rows.Speaker: Rui?
rows.Line:
Well, don't you look like you're having fun.
Nowadays, at least.

rows.Speaker: Rui?
rows.Line: When you were always all alone, before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miku. Len. Do you know what that is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... It's some kind of feeling that's taken form, I think.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-But it's a bit different from the feelings we know, and the fragments of feelings too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Your business is with me, yes?
Could you tell me what it is you want?

rows.Speaker: Rui?
rows.Line: No, there's no need for that.
